What is the equation of the parabola shown above?

feedback.problem: Find the equation of the right-opening parabola that has its vertex at $(0,0)$ and passes through the point $(5,5).$
feedback.worked_solution:
The general standard equation of a parabola whose vertex is $(0,0)$ and whose arms open right or left is given by

$$
{y}^{2}=4px.
$$

Since we know the given parabola passes through the point $(5,5),$ we can substitute $x=5$ and $y=5$ into the standard equation and solve for $p:$

$$
\begin{aligned}{y}^{2} & =4px \\ {5}^{2} & =4p(5) \\ 25 & =20p \\ p & =\frac{5}{4}\end{aligned}
$$

So, the equation of the parabola is 

$$
\begin{aligned}{y}^{2} & =4px \\ {y}^{2} & =4(\frac{5}{4})x \\ {y}^{2} & =5x.\end{aligned}
$$
